description:
Yuni, who graduated from art school without being cured of her "I'm special" disease, faces a society far harsher than a winter cold wave! Realizing that even living an ordinary life isn't easy, let alone being special, Yuni dreams of becoming an "ordinary" office worker, riding the hellish subway, rubbing her sleepy eyes, and drinking Americano...

 *"Life begins with admitting I'm a loser."* 

This is the bittersweet, sweet, and spicy story of a former artist and newbie in the workforce. When will Yuni finally be able to live an "ordinary life"?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
